newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks rally at close.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks rally at close.

text.p: Argentine stocks jumped at the close Friday on a raft of foreign buy orders, recouping mild losses posted in the previous three sessions, dealers said.

"The market was quiet early today because of the pressure of options expirations, but then it was pushed higher by Argentine debt and ADRs which saw a fresh round of buying," said dealer Emilio Alessandro of brokers Alessandro. "I think the market will follow through on these gains next week."
The blue-chip MerVal index .MERV climbed 1.8 percent to 740.86, showing a weekly gain of 2.1 percent.
"The next technical resistance level is 750," another trader said.
The broad market added 2.1 percent, with winners smashing losers 49 to six and 17 issues closing flat.
Floor volume picked up to 36.4 million pesos from 33 million Thursday, while over-the-counter turnover swelled to 93 million pesos from 62.6 million Thursday.
The day's strongest main-tier gains were in construction stock Polledo, which surged 7.3 percent, holding company Comercial del Plata, up 4.4 percent, and Telecom, up 3.7 percent.
The only MerVal loser was steelmaker Siderca, which shed 0.5 percent, while Banco Francs and petrochemical concern Ipako both closed unchanged.
